image_description: A close-up photograph of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a rough tree branch. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head, bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, white belly, and black back with white shoulder patches. The background is a soft, out-of-focus bokeh of blue sky and branches.
